purpose: Candidate-authored fixture/control inputs and hand-computed expected results for the affine geotransform witness. No designer-computed values; every expected number below was derived by hand from the frozen sources and is stated with its derivation. This file is INPUT ONLY for the sandboxed witness code.

units_and_conventions.pixel_line: p (pixel/column offset) and l (line/row offset) are unitless continuous coordinates; origin (0,0) is the top-left CORNER of the top-left pixel per geotransform.rst lines 30-32; integer pixel centers are (col+0.5, row+0.5).
units_and_conventions.georeferenced: X, Y are in the geotransform's CRS units: metres for projected-style fixtures, degrees for the geographic fixture.
units_and_conventions.coefficients: 0-based gt[0..5] per geotransform.rst lines 15-20: gt[0],gt[3] CRS units (corner origin); gt[1],gt[5] CRS units per pixel; gt[2],gt[4] CRS units per pixel (rotation terms, typically zero).
units_and_conventions.determinant_units: det = gt[1]*gt[5] - gt[2]*gt[4] carries (CRS units per pixel)^2.

source_binding.forward_equations: geotransform.rst lines 27-28, transcribed literally: X_geo = gt[0] + p*gt[1] + l*gt[2]; Y_geo = gt[3] + p*gt[4] + l*gt[5]
source_binding.corner_center_shift_witness: gdal_misc.cpp lines 2189-2193 subtract half of each of gt[1],gt[2] from gt[0] and half of gt[4],gt[5] from gt[3] to convert a pixel-center convention to the corner origin; the witness checks world(center)-world(corner) equals that half-pixel displacement.

hand_computed_forward_expectations.derivation: X=0+0.5*1+0.5*0=0.5; Y=0+0.5*0+0.5*(-1)=-0.5; differs from the corner point, confirming corner-vs-center separation
X=0+10*1=10; Y=0+5*(-1)=-5 (bottom-right corner of the 10x5 raster)

invertibility_policy.scale_relative_test: invertible iff r = |det| / (|gt[1]*gt[5]| + |gt[2]*gt[4]|) > tol_rel, with tol_rel = 1e-9; r in (0,1], r=1 for a diagonal north-up block, r=0 for every zero-determinant fixture
invertibility_policy.instability_warning: if r <= 1e-4 the inverse amplifies input error by ~1/r, so the inverse is flagged numerically untrustworthy (ill-conditioned) even though formally invertible; near_singular has r about 1e-6
invertibility_policy.absolute_det_floor: also require |det| > 0 exactly; both degenerate fixtures give det == 0.0 in binary floating point by construction

applicability.domain: six-coefficient GDAL-style affine geotransforms in any CRS; continuous pixel/line space with corner origin
applicability.not_applicable: polynomial or RPC georeferencing; integer-index pixel-center callers that skip the +0.5 mapping; extent containment policy (the affine map is total on R^2, out-of-extent queries are legal inputs to the math and only caller policy flags them)
applicability.environment: executed in the er10 mechanical sandbox only: offline, single process, stdlib-only /usr/bin/python3 -I -B; GDAL itself is NOT executed, so GDALGCPsToGeoTransform is used here only as a witnessed-source concept (gdal_misc.cpp lines 1811, 2006), not as an executed oracle
